about.biography:
Hello, I'm Threona!

I am a Technical Artist, Game Developer, and Software Engineer who loves standing at the intersection of logical engineering and digital art.

My passion lies in crafting games with groundbreaking experiences and compelling narratives, where every line of code and every frame serves to resonate with the player's emotions.
Beyond making games, I have a deep-seated love for building custom software and tools that streamline the game dev and graphics pipelines, turning the most ambitious ideas into smooth, playable realities.

When I close my laptop, you'll find me diving into virtual worlds as an avid gamer, losing myself in good music, hitting the open road for a road trip, or battling it out on the basketball court with friends.

experiences.title: Technical Artist
experiences.desc:
• Pipeline & Tool Development: Designed and implemented end-to-end character art pipelines, authoring custom Python automation scripts for Maya, Photoshop, and Blender to streamline/enhanced content creation and asset management.
  • Unreal Engine Tooling: Engineered in-editor workflow utilities and custom tools in Unreal Engine using Editor Utility Widgets and C++ to eliminate repetitive artist tasks and boost team productivity.
  • Full-Stack Pipeline Apps: Built standalone desktop/web pipeline tools using Python backends and React frontends, providing artists with intuitive interfaces to interact seamlessly with DCC software and asset management systems.
  • Shaders & Visual Effects: Authored real-time material shaders and dynamic particle/VFX systems in Unreal Engine, balancing high visual fidelity with strict
    frame-rate budget constraints.

experiences.title: Game Engineer
experiences.desc:
Implement and publish games on a sandbox platform. Using Lua and visual script to implement the feature of the game:
  • Ranking and leaderboard features for users
  • Room matching feature
  • Using round-robin algorithms to make the match matching schedule
  • Manage user data

experiences.title: Game Developer
experiences.desc:
Create a new game with the idea from the game designers.
  • Ported a C++ UWP game codebase across multi-platform targets, including Xbox, PlayStation, and Android.
  • Maintained and optimized In-App Purchase (IAP) integration across multiple platforms, ensuring reliable transaction processing and seamless user flow.
  • Prepared, configured, and deployed cross-platform game builds to storefronts such as Steam and Epic Games Store, ensuring compliance with platform release guidelines.
  • Conducted rigorous functional and regression testing across core APIs and game builds to catch critical bugs early and ensure seamless user experiences.
  • Automated project setup by writing custom Lua scripts to resolve dependencies, compile standalone source libraries, and link core modules into production builds.
  • Leveraged OpenGL, DirectX, and Vulkan to develop real-time graphic effects and graphics rendering pipelines.

experiences.title: C++ Programmer Intern

Work with senior developer to manage large, complex design of project structure.
  • Complete detailed programming and development tasks for APIs.
  • Carry out quality assurance tests to discover errors and optimize usability.
  • Make an automation operation process by using Jenkins.
  • Setup build tool for game using Batch/Bash and Lua script.
  • Using Lua to setup the project game from discrete source code and build the libs then connect to the project.
